unit.label: Order a drink · for here or to go
unit.title: A Drink to Go
unit.description: 7 new words and expressions. Order cups of hot tea or coffee, choose a size, and say whether your order is for here or to go.

goal.text: 我要一杯熱茶，外帶，謝謝。
goal.pinyin: Wǒ yào yì bēi rè chá, wàidài, xièxie.
goal.meaning: I would like a cup of hot tea to go, thank you.

unit.bookReference: A Course in Contemporary Chinese 1 · Lesson 4 請問一共多少錢？ · Dialogue I pp. 66–68; measure-word structure pp. 70–71. Ordering slice; numbers, prices and the remaining shopping grammar are deferred.

lessons.title: One Cup or Two?
lessons.subtitle: Order cups of tea and coffee with 杯.

steps.prompt: Which part of 一杯茶 counts cups?
steps.explanation: 一 gives the number, 杯 gives the measure, and 茶 names the drink.

steps.prompt: You are ordering two cups of coffee. Which order matches?
steps.explanation: Match both the quantity 兩杯 and the drink 咖啡.
The audio says yì bēi chá: one cup of tea.

steps.prompt: One cup of tea and two cups of coffee are ordered. Which drink has two cups?
steps.explanation: 兩杯咖啡 means two cups of coffee.

steps.prompt: 這杯咖啡很熱 tells you about what?
steps.explanation: 熱 means hot. 好喝, already learned, describes good taste.
The audio says rè kāfēi: hot coffee.

steps.prompt: Which phrase means “two cups of hot tea”?
steps.explanation: Use quantity + cup measure + temperature + drink.

steps.prompt: A drink tastes good, but you have not said its temperature. Which description gives only the taste?
steps.explanation: 好喝 is a familiar taste description; 熱 is a different property.

lessons.title: Buy a Drink, Choose a Size
lessons.subtitle: Add 買 and the medium size 中杯.

steps.prompt: Which action means buying, rather than drinking?
steps.explanation: 買 is to buy. 喝 is to drink.

steps.prompt: The staff asks 你要大杯、中杯還是小杯？ You want medium. What do you say?
steps.explanation: 中 is medium in this size question.

steps.prompt: Does 買一杯茶 necessarily mean you drink the tea yourself?
options: No; it only says you buy a cup of tea
steps.answer: No; it only says you buy a cup of tea
steps.explanation: Buying and drinking are separate actions.

lessons.title: Take It to Go
lessons.subtitle: Learn 外帶 and both of its characters.

steps.explanation: The two fourth tones wàidài mean to go.

steps.prompt: You will take your tea away. Which phrase tells the staff that?
steps.explanation: 外帶 is about taking it away; the other phrases give temperature or size.

steps.prompt: In 我要一杯茶，外帶, which detail is still unspecified?
options: The cup size: large, medium, or small
steps.answer: The cup size: large, medium, or small
steps.explanation: 一杯 specifies one cup, and 外帶 says to go. No size was chosen.

lessons.title: For Here, Please
lessons.subtitle: Recognize and answer 外帶還是內用？

steps.explanation: The audio says nèiyòng: for here.

steps.prompt: You plan to sit here with your drink. Answer 外帶還是內用？
steps.explanation: 內用 says you will have the order here.

steps.prompt: The staff asks 外帶還是內用？ What information do they want?
options: Whether you will take it away or have it here
Whether you want tea or coffee
Whether you want one cup or two
steps.answer: Whether you will take it away or have it here
steps.explanation: 還是 offers the two already-taught service choices.

lessons.title: Complete Your Order
lessons.subtitle: Follow a short conversation at the counter.

steps.prompt: The staff replies 好的 after your choice. What does it mean?
steps.explanation: 好的 acknowledges your choice. 好喝 is the taste expression.

steps.prompt: You said 我要一杯熱茶，外帶，謝謝. Which order should the staff prepare?
steps.explanation: 一杯 is one cup, 熱茶 is hot tea, and 外帶 is to go.

steps.prompt: You want a small cup. Reply to the size question.
steps.explanation: 小杯 answers the size question; 內用 answers a different question.

steps.prompt: You are taking this order away. Reply to the service question.
steps.explanation: Give the service choice: 外帶.

steps.prompt: The staff repeats your correct order. Which reply politely acknowledges it?
steps.explanation: 好的 acknowledges the message and 謝謝 adds thanks.

steps.prompt: You have ordered a drink, selected a size, and chosen 外帶. What does the final choice tell the staff?
steps.explanation: The service choice is separate from drink, size, and temperature.

lessons.title: Unit Challenge
lessons.subtitle: Order a drink and answer the follow-up questions. No new material.

steps.prompt: Which order asks for two cups of coffee?
steps.explanation: Match the number and the drink.
Listen for rè kāfēi: hot coffee.

steps.prompt: You want to buy a cup of tea. Which sentence says that?
steps.explanation: 買 is to buy; 喝 is to drink.

steps.prompt: Choose the medium cup.
steps.explanation: 中杯 is medium.
外帶 means to go.

steps.prompt: You plan to stay here. How do you answer 外帶還是內用？
steps.explanation: 內用 means for here.

steps.prompt: Which reply means “OK; all right”?
steps.explanation: 好的 is an acknowledgment.

steps.prompt: Your order is one hot tea to go, medium size. Which exchange completes the size choice correctly?
options: A：你要大杯、中杯還是小杯？ B：中杯。
A：你要大杯、中杯還是小杯？ B：內用。
A：你要大杯、中杯還是小杯？ B：兩杯。
steps.answer: A：你要大杯、中杯還是小杯？ B：中杯。
steps.explanation: 中杯 answers size. 內用 is service, and 兩杯 is quantity.

newVocabulary.meaning: cup; measure word for cups of a drink

newVocabulary.note: You know the character from 中文. The new meaning here is medium: 中杯.
A complete acknowledgment. The 的 is light; learn 好的 as a fixed reply here.

杯.meaning: cup; measure word for cups of a drink
杯.note: 杯 counts cups of a drink: 一杯茶. Use it in place of the general measure word 個 for this meaning.
杯.memory: 杯 places 木 on the left and the familiar 不 on the right. Keep the left 木 narrow so the two sides stay distinct.

parts.label: 木
parts.name: wood component
parts.description: Write the horizontal, vertical, left-falling stroke, then the small right-hand stroke of the narrow 木.

parts.label: 不
parts.name: right-hand component
parts.description: The four strokes form 不. Recognize the shape, but do not read this component as a negative inside 杯.

熱.note: 熱 describes temperature: 熱咖啡 is hot coffee. It does not mean that the coffee tastes good.
熱.memory: 熱 has a broad upper 埶 and four separate fire dots 灬 below. Keep the bottom dots distinct from the small upper marks.

parts.label: 埶
parts.name: upper component
parts.description: These eleven strokes form the broad upper structure. Its left side is built from short crossing strokes; its right side has a curved hook and a dot.

parts.label: 灬
parts.name: fire dots
parts.description: Finish with four separate dots spread across the base. This fire component helps recall the meaning hot.

買.note: 買 means to buy. 想買 means would like to buy; the verb 買 comes before the thing being bought.
買.memory: 買 stacks a wide 罒 over 貝. The lower 貝 has a tall box and two spreading strokes at its feet.

parts.label: 罒
parts.name: top frame
parts.description: These five strokes make the wide top frame with internal vertical divisions.

parts.label: 貝
parts.name: shell component
parts.description: Seven strokes form 貝 below. Keep its inner horizontals inside the tall box, then add the two lower strokes. 貝 is a useful clue to money-related meanings.

外.meaning: outside; first syllable of 外帶
外.note: 外 begins 外帶, to go. Learn the complete expression for taking an order away.
外.memory: 外 puts 夕 on the left and 卜 on the right. The small inner mark of 夕 stays inside the left shape.

parts.label: 夕
parts.name: left component
parts.description: Write the short left-falling stroke, the longer bent stroke, then the small inner mark.

parts.label: 卜
parts.name: right component
parts.description: Write the tall vertical and then the short mark to its right. Leave a clear gap from 夕.

帶.meaning: carry; final syllable of 外帶
帶.note: 帶 completes 外帶, to go. Both syllables have fourth tone: wàidài.
帶.memory: 帶 has an interlocking top, a broad cover 冖, and a hanging 巾 below. The final vertical runs through the lower cloth-shaped part.

parts.label: 廿 + 儿
parts.name: upper structure
parts.description: The first six strokes form the interlocking top and its two lower turns. Keep this structure above the separate cover.

parts.label: 冖
parts.name: middle cover
parts.description: The next two strokes make a wide cover over the lower 巾.

parts.label: 巾
parts.name: cloth component
parts.description: The final three strokes form 巾. Its long central vertical drops below the side strokes.

內.meaning: inside; first syllable of 內用
內.note: 內 begins 內用, for here. Notice the Traditional form: the shape inside is 入.
內.memory: 內 surrounds 入 with an open-bottom frame 冂. The two inner slanting strokes stay within the frame.

parts.label: 冂
parts.name: outer frame
parts.description: Write the left side, then the top-and-right hooked stroke to make an open-bottom frame.

parts.label: 入
parts.name: inside component
parts.description: The last two strokes form 入 inside the frame. Watch where the two slanting strokes meet near the top.

用.meaning: use; final syllable of 內用
用.note: 用 completes 內用, for here. At a drink counter, this means you will have your drink on the premises.
用.memory: 用 has a tall outer frame, two inner horizontal bars, and one long central vertical through them.

parts.label: 用
parts.name: use component
parts.description: Begin with the left side and the hooked top-right side. Add the two inner horizontals, then finish with the central vertical.

u11-cup.title: Count cups of a drink
u11-cup.explanation: 杯, bēi, counts cups of a drink. You already know number + measure word + noun. Here use 杯: 一杯茶 is one cup of tea and 兩杯茶 is two cups of tea. Keep 兩 before the measure word. At the counter, the familiar 我要 can introduce your order.

examples.meaning: I would like one cup of tea.
I would like two cups of coffee.

u11-cup.remember: Number → 杯 → drink. Use 兩杯 for two cups.

u11-hot.title: Make it hot
u11-hot.pattern: 熱 + drink; drink + 很 + 熱
u11-hot.explanation: 熱, rè, means hot. 熱茶 is hot tea and 熱咖啡 is hot coffee. For these familiar short descriptions, place 熱 directly before the drink without 的. When you describe a drink in a sentence, use the pattern you already know: 這杯茶很熱. Temperature and taste are separate: 熱 is hot; 好喝 means tastes good.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào yì bēi rè chá.
examples.meaning: I would like a cup of hot tea.
This cup of coffee is hot.

u11-hot.remember: 一杯熱茶: one + cup + hot + tea. 熱 describes temperature.

u11-buy.title: Say what you want to buy
u11-buy.explanation: 買, mǎi, means to buy. Put it before the thing you are buying. 想買 uses the familiar 想 + action pattern: 我想買一杯茶. 買 is about buying, while 喝 is about drinking; you can buy a drink for someone else.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì bēi chá.
examples.meaning: I would like to buy a cup of tea.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi liǎng bēi rè kāfēi.
examples.meaning: I want to buy two cups of hot coffee.

u11-buy.remember: 買 = buy; 喝 = drink. The item follows 買.

u11-size.title: Choose a cup size
u11-size.pattern: 大杯 / 中杯 / 小杯
u11-size.explanation: You know 大 and 小. The new word meaning is 中, zhōng, medium. At a drink counter, 大杯, 中杯 and 小杯 mean large, medium and small cup sizes. You have already written 中 in 中文, so it is a new vocabulary meaning, not a new character. When asked about size, a short answer such as 中杯 is complete. The familiar 還是 asks you to choose.

examples.text: 你要大杯、中杯還是小杯？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào dà bēi, zhōng bēi háishi xiǎo bēi?
examples.meaning: Would you like a large, medium, or small cup?
I would like a medium cup.

u11-size.remember: Size answers: 大杯 large, 中杯 medium, 小杯 small.

u11-takeout.title: Take your order with you
u11-takeout.explanation: 外帶, wàidài, means to go or takeout. Say it after your order to tell the staff you will take the food or drink away. It can also stand alone as the answer about how you will have your order. Both syllables use fourth tone. Do not use 外帶 to mean that you want to buy a cup: it describes how you will have the order.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào yì bēi chá, wàidài.
examples.meaning: I would like one cup of tea to go.

u11-takeout.remember: 外帶 = take the order away. Say the order, then 外帶.

u11-here.title: For here or to go?
u11-here.pattern: 外帶還是內用？ → 外帶 / 內用
u11-here.explanation: 內用, nèiyòng, means for here or dine in: you will have the order on the premises. A common question is 外帶還是內用？ The familiar 還是 offers two choices. Answer with the choice you want. You do not need 嗎 after this choice question.
u11-here.remember: Taking it away? 外帶. Staying here? 內用.

u11-okay.title: Acknowledge an order
u11-okay.explanation: 好的, hǎo de, is a short acknowledgment: OK or all right. The 的 has a light neutral tone here. Learn the whole reply; this is not the possessive 的 pattern. Staff can say 好的 after receiving your choice. 好的 acknowledges a message, while 好喝 describes how a drink tastes.
u11-okay.remember: 好的 = OK. It can acknowledge an order or request.

u11-one-tea.meaning: I would like one cup of tea.
u11-one-tea.note: Use the drink measure word 杯.

u11-two-coffee.meaning: I would like two cups of coffee.

u11-hot-tea.pinyin: Wǒ yào yì bēi rè chá.
u11-hot-tea.meaning: I would like a cup of hot tea.

u11-coffee-hot.meaning: This cup of coffee is hot.
u11-coffee-hot.note: Here the sentence describes the temperature of a specific drink.

u11-buy-tea.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì bēi chá.
u11-buy-tea.meaning: I would like to buy a cup of tea.
u11-buy-tea.note: 想 is already familiar; 買 gives the new action.

u11-buy-two.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi liǎng bēi rè kāfēi.
u11-buy-two.meaning: I want to buy two cups of hot coffee.
u11-buy-two.note: Read the item phrase as two cups of hot coffee.

u11-size-question.text: 你要大杯、中杯還是小杯？
u11-size-question.pinyin: Nǐ yào dà bēi, zhōng bēi háishi xiǎo bēi?
u11-size-question.meaning: Would you like a large, medium, or small cup?
u11-size-question.note: A familiar choice question with a new medium size.

u11-medium.meaning: I would like a medium cup.
u11-medium.note: The drink is already understood from the conversation.

u11-tea-go.pinyin: Wǒ yào yì bēi chá, wàidài.
u11-tea-go.meaning: I would like a cup of tea to go.
u11-tea-go.note: 外帶 tells the staff how you will have it.

u11-go-thanks.note: A short reply about your order.

u11-here-thanks.note: You plan to drink it here.

u11-coffee-here.pinyin: Wǒ yào yì bēi rè kāfēi, nèiyòng.
u11-coffee-here.meaning: I would like a cup of hot coffee for here.
u11-coffee-here.note: The final choice is about staying here.

u11-okay-thanks.note: 好的 is a complete acknowledgment.

u11-full-order.text: 我要一杯熱茶，外帶，謝謝。
u11-full-order.pinyin: Wǒ yào yì bēi rè chá, wàidài, xièxie.
u11-full-order.meaning: I would like a cup of hot tea to go, thank you.
u11-full-order.note: Order → how you will have it → thanks.
